style: Style: a children's picture-book painting in flat matte gouache on warm, visibly textured paper; hand-cut shapes with slightly imperfect edges and fine hand-drawn gold line. Ancient Near-Eastern and Persian garden-kingdom stylization: gentle profile and three-quarter figures, frieze rhythm, flat stacked space, patterned textile-like borders. A gentle magical boho warmth with a few tiny warm fairy-light specks painted as flat round dots. Calm negative space. Palette: lapis blue, midnight navy, mustard gold, terracotta, ivory, gold line, olive and sage greens, pomegranate red, small teal and rose accents.
avoid: No text, letters, numerals or script-like marks anywhere. Modest dress for everyone: long sleeves and long robes or dresses. No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no glossy gradients.
cast: The people are the characters from image 1, the character sheet: copy their faces, hair, clothes and colours exactly. Amitai is the curly-haired boy of about nine in the cream linen tunic with the indigo sash; the princess is the eight-year-old girl with one dark braid, a thin gold circlet and the rose-and-saffron dress; the king has the soft white beard, the low gold crown and the lapis-blue robe; the sages are the two grey-bearded old men in olive and plum. Amitai's clay pot is always the same small terracotta pot with one painted blue band. Only the characters named in the scene appear.
sheet_prompt: Character design sheet for a children's picture book, on plain warm ivory textured paper. Five characters stand side by side in one row, full body, front view, evenly spaced, not overlapping: 1) Amitai, a slender boy of about nine with warm olive-brown skin, a mop of dark curly hair, big dark eyes and a gentle face, in a simple undyed cream linen tunic to the knees with a narrow indigo sash, loose trousers and plain leather sandals, holding a small terracotta clay pot with one painted blue band; 2) the princess, a girl of eight with long dark hair in one braid, a thin gold circlet, and a modest long-sleeved dress in rose and saffron reaching her ankles; 3) the king, a kind elderly man with a soft white beard and gentle eyes, a simple low gold crown, and a long lapis-blue robe with a gold-embroidered collar and long sleeves; 4) and 5) two elderly sages with long grey beards, one in an olive robe holding a rolled scroll, the other in a plum robe with a wooden staff. Friendly faces with simple features, all drawn in the same style. scenes.cover: Picture-book cover. Amitai stands in the centre foreground holding his small clay pot with a thin green stem and three small leaves, looking at it with quiet joy. Behind him, softly, the palace garden of a Persian-style kingdom with huge colourful flowers, cypresses and turquoise-tiled arches. The top third of the picture is a calm, plain warm sky with nothing in it, for the title.
scenes.p01: In the palace garden of a Persian-style kingdom, the kind king walks hand in hand with the little princess along a narrow water channel between cypresses and blooming pomegranate trees; the sandstone palace with turquoise-tiled arches stands behind; soft morning light; tender, happy mood.
scenes.p02: On a palace terrace at sunset, the king rests one hand on his beard and smiles thoughtfully, looking out over far villages, fields and orchards; beside him the princess feeds a small bird perched on the balustrade.
scenes.p03: At the palace gate a royal herald in a teal tabard stands on the steps blowing a long golden trumpet; across the land below, children aged eight to ten pop up from rooftops, doorways and fields, looking up and starting to run toward the palace; banners flutter.
scenes.p04: The great palace courtyard is filled with a lively crowd of children in simple colourful clothes, standing in loose rows and gazing up, wide-eyed; at the far end, on a short flight of steps, the king stands with the princess and the two sages; turquoise tiles and tall cypresses frame the scene.
scenes.p05: A warm close moment: the king bends down and places one tiny brown seed into the open palm of a small girl; behind her a line of children waits, each with an open palm; Amitai is in the line, curious, watching the seed.
scenes.p06: The children raise their closed fists high with their seeds and cheer; the king on the palace steps announces with one open hand raised; the princess beside him claps; doves fly up; joyful energy.
scenes.p07: Early morning at a small mud-brick house with a blue wooden door at the edge of a village: Amitai kneels on the doorstep, gently pressing the seed into the soil of his small clay pot; a little clay water jug stands beside him; sunrise over the hills; a rooster on the low wall.
scenes.p08: A whimsical panorama of the kingdom busy with seeds: flat rooftops and windowsills crowded with clay pots; one child waters, one sings to a pot, one reads a scroll to it, one shades it with a big palm leaf, one tucks a tiny blanket around it; small and almost hidden in a corner of the market, one child quietly swaps an empty pot for a flower from a flower seller's stall.
scenes.p09: Amitai sits on his doorstep beside his clay pot of bare dark soil, chin on his hands, patient; across the sky above him a frieze of days passes over the same pot: a sun, a rain cloud, a crescent moon, another sun; a small watering jug in his lap; he keeps going.
scenes.p10: Morning on the doorstep: Amitai kneels with a joyful, amazed face before his clay pot, where a thin green stem with three small leaves has just come up; soft golden light falls on the leaves; a small butterfly flutters near.
scenes.p11: The big day: a joyful parade of children walks along the road toward the palace gate, each carrying a pot with an enormous flower taller than the child: giant roses, lotuses, sunflowers, irises and peonies in every colour, too big and too perfect; banners and drums; festive.
scenes.p12: Inside his small dim house, Amitai stands behind the half-open blue door holding his little clay pot with three leaves, watching the bright flower parade pass in the lane outside; he lowers his eyes, ashamed; the lane outside is sunny and colourful, his doorway shadowed and quiet.
scenes.p13: In the palace courtyard packed with children holding huge flowers, the two sages count with a long unrolled scroll; one sage leans toward the king and raises a single finger; the king looks around the crowd, searching, a little worried.
scenes.p14: Two royal messengers in teal tabards stand at Amitai's blue door; Amitai holds his little clay pot with three leaves against his chest, eyes down, sad; his mother, in a modest long dress and headscarf, stands behind him with a gentle hand on his shoulder.
scenes.p15: In the palace hall full of children with giant flowers, Amitai stands small before the throne, holding up his little clay pot with three leaves; the king leans forward with a warm, wide smile, one hand stretched toward him; the princess smiles; the children stare in surprise.
scenes.p16: The king holds up a tiny dry grey seed between two fingers, showing it to everyone; the two sages raise their hands in astonishment; the children with giant flowers look down at their flowers, embarrassed, a few hiding their faces behind big petals; Amitai looks up, wondering.
scenes.p17: Close-up, tender: Amitai's small clay pot with three green leaves, held in his two hands; the king's large gentle hand cups the pot from below, and the princess's small hand touches one leaf; their faces are seen from the side, smiling; the leaves glow softly.
scenes.p18: Years later, in the palace garden: a beautiful young tree full of pale blossoms grows from a big planter; Amitai and the princess, now about twelve, water it together from clay jugs; the old king watches smiling from a stone bench; Amitai's little clay pot with the blue band rests at the foot of the tree.
